verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists, so an agent can connect through a first-party server. The evidence is a single one-line mention covering the whole Stripe API rather than Invoicing specifically, so complete coverage of the story is not shown. missing for 10: documentation that invoice operations are exposed as MCP tools, setup/authentication and tool-scope details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it with Invoicing

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
